name: Content library hero with logo strip and 2-col feature
purpose: Open the content-library page with its sub-brand lockup, H1 and tour CTA, then prove it with customer logos and a why-choose-us feature with a quote.
description: Legacy content ('yellow') theme, three parts (/content): (1) a hairline-framed centred hero: sub-brand lockup, serif 3.8rem H1, paragraph, yellow pill button + 3 overlapping avatars and a social line; (2) a one-line caption and 6-logo row; (3) a 2-column feature: serif 3.5rem H2, grey paragraphs with two inline links, quote card with avatar, name and role | square image card with a yellow button. The feature stacks <=767.

evidenceNotes: Feature text uses a [[link phrase]] markup parsed by rich(); the sample text has the brackets removed and lists the phrases in linkPhrases.
Logo labels are 'Logo 1'..'Logo 6' (text LogoPlaceholders); the sample uses the first label.
The sub-brand lockup and yellow theme are hard-coded (no theme prop), so no theme field.
The sub-brand logo slot (own brand, not a customer) has no matching asset role; it is modelled as the text field brandLockup.
